You first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has no further detail on the guard. The only later mention is Mateo's message at 11:03 AM, saying kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. So the guard was logging trailers by hand from at least 10:42 until kiosk 1 came back at 11:03. You also noted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
